name: Luke Samios
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: I am a person-centred counsellor who believes that meaningful change begins with feeling genuinely heard, understood and accepted. I provide a warm, collaborative and non-judgemental space where you can explore what is happening in your life at your own pace. I have experience supporting people through grief and loss, substance use, significant life changes, depression and anxiety, stress and burnout, as well as working with LGBTIQ+ clients.
specialties: Gay, Lesbian & Bisexual issues, Posttraumatic stress disorder, Transgender, Gender Identity and Intersex issues, Trauma recovery

name: Kimberley Kifun
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: Hi I am Kimberley, an integrative psychotherapist committed to creating a safe and welcoming space where you can explore all aspects of yourself. Rather than focusing solely on problem-solving, I view therapy as a space to foster self-compassion for all parts of yourself, understand how past experiences shape present patterns, and cultivate resilience for a fulfilling life. As an integrative psychotherapist, I draw on a variety of therapeutic approaches, including Attachment, Trauma, Psychodynamic, Somatic, Internal Family Systems, and Transpersonal models. I can help you with a broad range of concerns, including anxiety, depression, trauma, relationship issues, grief, and existential concerns.
specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Sex and sexual issues, Trauma recovery, Somatic Experiencing, Somatic psychotherapy

name: Ohad Rein
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: Hi, I’m Ohad - a psychotherapist, counsellor, and lifelong explorer of the human experience. My approach to therapy is rooted in connection, growth, and integration, blending a wide range of therapeutic modalities with over two decades of experience in therapy, music, production, meditation, yoga, and Western and Eastern philosophy. I specialise in person-centred, trauma-informed, Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT), attachment repair, existential, mindfulness, somatic, emotional and transpersonal therapies, tailoring each session to your unique needs and story.
specialties: Gay, Lesbian & Bisexual issues, Posttraumatic stress disorder, Sex and sexual issues, Transgender, Gender Identity and Intersex issues, Trauma recovery, Somatic psychotherapy

name: Meg A. Wilson
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Here's a tighter version, front-loaded so the first two sentences carry the whole pitch: --- Meg Wilson is the founder of Unison Mental Health, a Melbourne therapy practice for people navigating relationship complexity, identity, and self-expression — including LGBTQIA+ clients and those exploring non-traditional relationship structures. She's trained in art psychotherapy, DBT, mindfulness, and emotion-focused therapy, and brings genuine curiosity to understanding what's actually going on for each client, shaped by their cultural background and worldview. **Based in Carlton, Melbourne. Telehealth available across Australia.**
specialties: Gay, Lesbian & Bisexual issues, Posttraumatic stress disorder, Sex and sexual issues, Transgender, Gender Identity and Intersex issues, Trauma recovery, Somatic Experiencing, Somatic psychotherapy

name: Jacqui Cousins
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: I believe a culture of care is essential to improving the health of our community. I have spent 20+ years working in the community health sector and I am qualified in mental health and counselling. My experience includes counselling youth, adults, women living with chronic illness & pain, and people living with complex health issues.
specialties: Gay, Lesbian & Bisexual issues, Posttraumatic stress disorder, Transgender, Gender Identity and Intersex issues, Trauma recovery

name: Katalina Montaigue
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: Life might look full, and on paper it might even look good, but something feels missing. You may feel stuck, overwhelmed, disconnected from yourself, or caught in patterns that keep repeating. But they're asking, in one way or another, "Who am I?" and "What am I doing with this life?" They're not necessarily looking for answers as much as space to explore what is actually true for them, and to reconnect with the parts of themselves that have gone quiet beneath years of adapting, coping and surviving.

name: Louise Gourley
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Over the past 25 years I have honed my experience by embracing a wide range of counselling areas, including, but not limited to, drug and alcohol, carers, mental health, domestic violence, family and relationships, elderly and dementia, intellectual disabilities, crisis and suicide prevention, PTSD, grief and loss, career and life issues, severe mental health disorders, addictions, depression and anxiety, homelessness and sexual orientation, to name a few. The variety of people I have worked with is far ranging – from farmers to captains of industry – everyone needs support at some stage. I have trained within these areas as well as obtaining my Counselling Degree, Diploma and Clinical Supervision qualifications and continue to embrace learning and research as an ongoing opportunity to offer clients the best practice.
specialties: Gay, Lesbian & Bisexual issues, Posttraumatic stress disorder, Transgender, Gender Identity and Intersex issues, Trauma recovery
